constraints: As of 4D 19 R5, for Web areas using the Windows system rendering engine, this command fills the menu with only the current URL.
Call RELEASE MENU to delete a URL history menu when it is no longer needed.

overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines only because the leading semicolon disappears when the leading '*' is omitted (object becomes Variable/Field instead of Text). Semantically this is one overload with '*' an optional literal-symbol discriminator, matching the WA-EXECUTE-JAVASCRIPT-FUNCTION fixture's treatment of the same pattern.

params.description: If specified, object is an object name (Text); if omitted, object is a variable or field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or variable/field (if * is omitted) designating the Web area

params.name: direction
params.description: Which URL list to build the menu from

sentinelValues.meaning: 0 (default if omitted): list of previous URLs.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Creates and fills a menu (returning its reference) usable for direct navigation among the URLs visited during the session in the designated Web area.
